title: Thamanya
description: Spec campaign — 14 posters for the Thamanya podcast episode “The Fall of Andalusia”, one poster for each era of listening, from the gramophone to streaming.

caseStudy.title: Thamanya
caseStudy.idea: A poster campaign for the podcast episode "The Fall of Andalusia". Imaginary designs, each poster for a medium from a different era, from the gramophone to streaming platforms, with the campaign's visual identity.
caseStudy.research: Mapped how listening changed across eras — gramophone, radio, cassette, streaming — so each poster could carry its own time without losing the campaign identity.
caseStudy.execution: Built a shared visual system first — palette, type treatment and framing — then generated and finished 14 posters in that system, one per medium.
caseStudy.goal: Give one podcast episode a campaign identity strong enough to work across 14 posters, each from a different era of listening.
caseStudy.challenge: Keeping 14 very different eras — gramophone to streaming — feeling like one campaign instead of 14 separate posters.
caseStudy.result: 14 posters in one visual system, each tied to its era, ready to use as a full campaign for the episode.

title: Cap by Ibnmajdi
description: Self-initiated product campaign — 14 studio and lifestyle visuals for caps, a product few brands advertise well.

caseStudy.title: Cap by Ibnmajdi
caseStudy.idea: An ad for a product few advertise: caps. Studio shots, model photography, and a product detail sheet.
caseStudy.research: Looked at how caps are usually shot — flat product shots only — and planned the missing pieces: studio, model, street and a detail sheet.
caseStudy.execution: Generated consistent studio and model shots in one light and palette, then finished them in Canva and Hypic for a ready-to-post campaign.
caseStudy.goal: Prove a cap can carry a full product campaign — studio, model and detail — not just a flat product shot.
caseStudy.challenge: Caps have almost no advertising language of their own, so every shot had to be invented from the product itself.
caseStudy.result: 14 consistent visuals covering studio, model, street and a product detail sheet.

title: Athath
description: Self-initiated brand concept — 4 visuals for Athath, sculpted furniture floating above Cairo: “More than a home, a brighter tomorrow.”

caseStudy.title: Athath
caseStudy.idea: A self-initiated furniture brand concept: sculpted pieces floating in the sky above Cairo, under the promise "More than a home, a brighter tomorrow."
caseStudy.research: Started from the promise — furniture as a brighter tomorrow — and looked for a visual that could carry it without a showroom: floating pieces above the city.
caseStudy.execution: Built 4 surreal but consistent scenes in the same sky, light and scale, so the concept reads as one brand, not four separate images.
caseStudy.goal: Turn a furniture brand promise — 'a brighter tomorrow' — into a visual idea without a showroom.
caseStudy.challenge: Surreal floating furniture can easily look random; the four scenes had to read as one brand idea.
caseStudy.result: 4 visuals in the same sky, light and scale, carrying the brand promise without a single showroom shot.

title: Rox Adams 26
description: Concept automotive film — an SUV designed from a blank page, launched in a short film set in a surreal desert of glass monoliths.

caseStudy.title: Rox Adams 26
caseStudy.idea: A car ad exploring the limits of storyboard writing and AI ad direction: an SUV designed from a blank page, launched with a short film in a surreal desert of glass monoliths.
caseStudy.tools: ChatGPT, Google Flow (Omni Flash 2.1), Adobe Premiere, CapCut Desktop, Suno
caseStudy.research: Explored the limits of AI ad direction: what a storyboard needs before generation, and how to keep one car recognisable across surreal scenes.
caseStudy.execution: Wrote the storyboard, generated the film in Google Flow, and edited it in Premiere and CapCut with a Suno score — 3 stills plus the film.
caseStudy.goal: Test how far AI ad direction can go: design an SUV from a blank page and launch it with a short film.
caseStudy.challenge: Keeping one invented car recognisable across surreal scenes — glass monoliths, desert, shifting light — generated shot by shot.
caseStudy.result: A short film plus 3 stills, with the same car holding the story from first frame to last.
